source.note: known-divergences.md, tokenless-empty-forms: mermaid.js reads no token for the empty string and has the vertex `A:::c`; this specification rejects the input. The reference input `A:::c` joins `:` and `::` into `:::`, and mermaid.js reads the vertex `A` with the class `c` from it, so the reference input does not give the same Db.
